summary: BrainsWay Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a press release dated October 13, 2026, announcing expanded U.S. medical-policy coverage for its SWIFT Accelerated Deep TMS protocol, now exceeding 70 million covered lives. CEO Hadar Levy commented on adoption pathways and the clinical evidence base across FDA-cleared indications including MDD and OCD. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 and F-3 registration statements, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
